title: Schlessinger (S1), descent to test subalgebras, and minimality
statement: Use the marked Artinian test category $\mathcal C_{R,k}$, its residue maps and transport presentation of a category $\mathcal F$ cofibred in groupoids from [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. Define (S1) to mean that for every $A_1\to A\leftarrow A_2$ with $A_2\to A$ surjective, the canonical comparison from $\mathcal F(A_1\times_A A_2)$ to the groupoid of pairs of objects with a specified isomorphism over $A$ is essentially surjective. A test subalgebra $S\subseteq A$ is an $R$-subalgebra whose restriction of the residue augmentation makes it a marked test algebra; its inclusion is the actual inclusion. For $x\in\mathcal F(A)$, define $\mathcal S_x$ to have objects a test subalgebra $S\subseteq A$, an object $y\in\mathcal F(S)$, and an arrow $y\to x$ over the inclusion; its arrows are the commuting triangles over $x$ in the total cofibred category. Such an object over $S$ is minimal when every arrow to it in $\mathcal S_x$ has the same underlying subalgebra $S$.
